excerpt:
[docs/load-balancers.md#create-one-and-put-projects-on-it]
A project names it in `pskit.yml`; every `pskit deploy` updates its route and `pskit remove` drops it: The path prefix is removed before the request reaches your functions (`/shop/orders` arrives as `/orders`) and sent in `X-Forwarded-Prefix: /shop`. `/shop` redirects to `/shop/`. A **cluster** can be attached instead; every deployment on it gets `/<service>/` (or `/<service>-<stage>/` when two stages of a service share the cluster), kept up to date on deploy, remove, join and leave: A project's own `balancer` setting wins over the cluster's route for that deployment. A project whose [placement groups](placement.md) run on several attached clusters gets one route, `/<service>/`, to the servers of all of them; each server passes another group's routes on to it.
